faq.q: Do I need to bring my car anywhere?
faq.a: No. We come to your location: home, hotel, office, villa, marina, compound or rental parking.
El Gouna, Hurghada, and Sahl Hasheesh. Makadi Bay, Soma Bay, Safaga and more Egypt locations are planned step by step.
We work by confirmed booking and can arrange late or night appointments when the team and area schedule are available.

faq.q: How long does the wash take?
faq.a: Usually between 30 and 60 minutes depending on car size, condition and service type.
For standard maintenance washes, yes. We use waterless-style products and microfiber technique designed to reduce unnecessary water waste.

faq.q: Can you clean the motor bay?
faq.a: Engine or motor bay cleaning is an add-on and must be confirmed first because every car condition is different.

faq.q: Can I ask for body only, inside only or wheels?
faq.a: Yes. Write the exact request in the notes field, such as body, inside, wheels, glass, seats, motor bay, wax or perfume.

faq.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: Cash, InstaPay, Vodafone Cash, Orange Cash, Fawry, and bank transfer.

faq.q: Can hotels or companies work with you?
faq.a: Yes. We offer partnership and fleet packages for hotels, offices, marinas, rental cars and compounds.

faq.q: Will you expand outside the Red Sea?
faq.a: Yes. Our vision is to grow step by step across Egypt after the Red Sea launch areas are stable.
